selected.intent: When and where the newly announced Miami GTA VI music festival takes place, who performs, and how the lottery-to-ticket purchase process works.

freshness.new_event_not_recycled: Newswire and its official localized indexes date this announcement November 9, 2026. The event takes place later, November 21, and is distinct from the November 19 game release.

nearby_existing_topics.reason_distinct: In-game radio and previews; not a real Miami music festival or its ticket process.
Recorded album and release formats; not an attendance lottery.
Original score and release date; Justice appearing in a DJ set is different news.

London retail experience, not the Miami festival.

alternative_not_published.reason: One-topic scope retained. Existing financial-calendar/preorder coverage is closer in intent. Unprecedented-preorder wording already appeared before today and should not be presented as a first revelation.

primary_sources.access: Direct shell metadata accessible; body client-rendered. Announcement date cross-checked against official Newswire and localized indexes.
facts: Announcement November 9, festival November 21, Mana Wynwood Miami, Rockstar and PlayStation, artists associated with the game and soundtrack.

primary_sources.access: Complete server HTML read, 594592 bytes. Visible event, ticket and venue policies parsed.
facts: Two stages; produced by creators of III Points.
Lineup includes Travis Scott, Cardi B, Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso, Metro Boomin, Justice DJ set.
Minimum 17, valid photo ID, maximum two tickets per purchaser, tickets non-transferable.
DICE account must match registration email and phone; drawing codes distributed by Laylo.
Registration closes November 10 at 16:00 ET; page lists drawing November 10 at 19:00 ET and selected-entrant sale November 11 at noon ET.
318 NW 23rd St, entrance through 5th Avenue, no on-site parking.

primary_sources.access: Official registration linked by Rockstar; direct HTML read, 6846 bytes. No form submitted.
facts: No purchase needed to enter; one entry per person; minimum 17.
Eligible winners selected randomly; SMS with code by November 10 at 19:00 ET.
Sale November 11 at noon ET, first come first served, limited availability.
Code single-use and not for resale/trade. Registration does not guarantee a code; a code does not guarantee tickets.

primary_sources.access: Official game homepage; November 19 release distinguished from November 21 festival.

timing_resolution.registration_terms: Selected entrants contacted by SMS BY November 10, 19:00 ET
timing_resolution.editorial_choice: Use by/until 19:00 for notification, not an assured instant delivery to every entrant.
